result.summary: Found 1 major missing navigation icon and 2 minor visual consistency issues with favorite buttons and time-badge formatting.

issues.description: Orders tab in the bottom navigation has no visible icon above the label, while Home, Search and Profile all display icons
issues.suggestion: Restore the missing Orders icon and ensure it uses the same size, style and inactive grey color as the Search and Profile icons

issues.description: Favorite heart button styling is inconsistent in Popular right now cards: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a bare white heart outline with no background container, while the next pizza card shows the heart inside a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite button style with the same circular scrim/background for contrast on all cards

issues.description: Delivery time badge format is inconsistent in Fastest near you row: third card shows '20-30 min' with spaces around the hyphen while first two cards show '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' without spaces
issues.suggestion: Standardize time-range formatting to a single pattern across all badges
